text:
sophie.docs: Quick heads-up — I'm adding a small availability banner for the new TW (Taiwan) region on the regions page. Need a copy check + i18n guidance + a short data-residency footnote. PR posted below :wave: liam.eng: where will the banner render? top of /regions or per-region detail page? sophie.docs: top of /regions list for the moment — scoped to regions that have different residency rules. It'll link to the per-region detail for full notes. Trying to keep it a 1-liner with a link and a tiny compliance flag. arun.legal: +1, legal needs the residency link to go to the canonical compliance page. Also we should avoid the words "guarantee" — use "provisioned for" or "configured for" instead. maya.i18n: FYI for translations: Chinese (TW) uses traditional chars and we need a shorter variant for mobile. JP has stricter char-limit for the banner (40 chars). Can you paste the exact English copy so I can pre-translate? sophie.docs: Working draft copy — happy to iterate. Snippet below (HTML/MD hybrid for docs site): ```html
Now available in Taiwan — Regional endpoints available; data residency options may vary. Learn more
``` liam.eng: looks fine. For SDK snippets, can we append region-aware header example? e.g. `X-Redwood-Region: tw` so devs know how to target it. sophie.docs: good call. I'll add one inline sample and call out the header. arun.legal: copy tweak request: change "data residency options may vary" -> "data residency availability depends on deployment type and region; see details." keeps it accurate. sophie.docs: updated snippet with legal wording: ```html
Now available in Taiwan — Regional endpoints available; data residency availability depends on deployment type and region. Learn more
``` maya.i18n: thanks — translating now. Quick question: do we have a translation key namespace for banners? e.g., `regions.banner.tw.title` so translators can find context. sophie.docs: not yet — I'll add keys in the i18n YAML. Proposed keys: `regions.banner.tw.title`, `regions.banner.tw.body`, `regions.banner.tw.link_text`. maya.i18n: perfect. I'll push translations in a follow-up PR. For JP mobile variant, suggest truncation: "TWで利用可能 — データ配備は条件あり" (will post exact). liam.eng: PR link? want to review code + SDK snippet placement. docbot: A new PR was opened by sophie.docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 (diff includes banner + SDK header example + i18n keys) :github: liam.eng: reviewing now :eyes: arun.legal: approved on wording — minor nit about punctuation in the link sentence, but not blocking. sophie.docs: thanks — I'll fix punctuation and land after maya's translation PR lands or we can ship EN-only and toggle translations off until done. Thoughts? maya.i18n: prefer to ship EN with `i18n:pending` flag so translators can follow up; prevents missing keys from showing as raw fallback. sophie.docs: ok will add `i18n: pending` flag and a TODO in the PR description. liam.eng: small follow-up: add example curl with `X-Redwood-Region: tw` in the SDK snippet so support tickets are easier to debug. sophie.docs: done in the PR patch. Final checklist for merge: - arun legal sign-off (done) - maya translation PR or i18n pending (in progress) - engineering review for snippet placement (liam) liam.eng: LGTM from eng side once the curl example in the right context. sophie.docs: great — will merge this afternoon after docbot runs the link-checker. Thanks all! :pray:
